title: Gold Rate Today October 27: Check latest Gold prices in Coimbatore, Nagpur, Visakhapatnam, Surat, Jaipur, Lucknow, Chandigarh & Other Cities - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Gold prices rose across most other cities today compared to yesterday. | Photo Credit: BHAWIKA CHHABRA
